title: Omega swarm wave manifest
description: Coordinator-written pre-assignment of board items to Devin Cloud sessions. tools/swarm/launch.py validates this shape by hand; this schema documents it and serves as a test fixture.

wave.description: Wave identifier used in titles, tags, and build/swarm/<wave>/ output.

max_acu_limit.description: Per-session ACU cap passed as max_acu_limit.

devin_mode.description: Only per-session knob; the model cannot be chosen; null means the org default mode. Omitted from the request when null.

secret_ids.description: Optional Devin organization secret ids injected as environment variables into every session of the wave (e.g. ["TYPESAFE_API_KEY"] enables the Jev test-selection augment on cloud VMs). Values never appear in prompts, receipts, or transcripts.

owner_label_prefix.description: Landing owner label prefix; sessions land as <prefix>-<session name>.

exclusions.description: Items or sessions excluded from this wave for current conflicts or blockers, not standing reservations for future waves.

item.description: Board item name; must appear as **<item>.** in the board file.

host.description: linux: a Devin Cloud session (plan/launch/status/report). local: an agent spawned by the coordinator on this machine in a Git worktree (the `local` subcommand).

owning_paths.description: Repository-relative paths this session owns; no two sessions in the same layer may share one.

layer.description: Dependency layer: the coordinator launches layer N only after layer N-1 has fully landed or parked. Overlap is only rejected inside one layer; a later layer may own paths an earlier layer touched.

suggested_first_slice.description: Optional hint rendered as a suggestion; the board item's acceptance governs.

host_gates.description: Environment/access and prerequisite checks that must pass before assignment. Expected-red customer acceptance belongs on the board or in suggested_first_slice, not here.

probe_only.description: Explicit feasibility investigation: verification_only is a planned outcome and failing host_gates are recorded. Cross-stage scope or expected-red customer acceptance alone does not warrant this mode.
